evidence_policy: Native UE player-view and cinematic captures only. Reference atlases, source checks and mockups never constitute visual, playability or creator approval.
story_policy: Prelude ends with real sea landing; Splashdown begins Chapter 1 Act 1. Ionia joins before Lyra. Reson and Aepex are later protagonists. Ship Starbourne remains locked.
capture_requirements: exact git revision and asset/map hash
native image or clip file hash

shots.composition: Wide coastal harbor reveal. Lead the eye to Ionia's paid engineering flyer.
shots.movement: Slow lateral crane; keep a traversable route visible.
shots.lighting: Late afternoon golden practicals, restrained teal reflected light.
shots.vfx: Salt haze, wind-driven cloth, wet stone, ship silhouette.
shots.interaction_handoff: Player regains movement and finds the flyer.

shots.composition: Readable hands, dial markings and physical harmonic engine components.
shots.movement: Gentle controlled push toward player-operated tuning component.
shots.lighting: Warm brass bounce against cool teal resonance pulses.
shots.vfx: Low-intensity harmonic rings, instrument needle, visible dust.
shots.interaction_handoff: Player manipulates the actual diagnostic apparatus.

shots.composition: Show Ionia at helm and Ender at engineering readout, equal narrative agency.
shots.movement: Steady shoulder-level two-shot; avoid disorienting cut.
shots.lighting: Natural skylight through geodesic glass, gentle amber instrument glow.
shots.vfx: Glass curvature, reflections, bounded bridge vibration.
shots.interaction_handoff: Ionia explicitly authorizes launch only after checks.

shots.composition: Four dragonfly wing silhouettes and hull scale remain readable.
shots.movement: Tracking profile to three-quarter elevation; no impossible teleport.
shots.lighting: Golden port light shifts into clear open sky.
shots.vfx: Articulating wings, restrained propulsion wake, disturbed dock spray.
shots.interaction_handoff: Ship visibly disengages and begins controlled climb.

shots.composition: Believable planetary horizon curvature with layered cloud depth.
shots.movement: Exterior wide gliding tracking shot to cockpit/window view.
shots.lighting: High-altitude daylight, thin atmospheric scattering, auroral lane accents.
shots.vfx: Volumetric cloud parallax and non-occluding auroral traces.
shots.interaction_handoff: Player observes flight; no Starbourne gate or premature crew join.

shots.composition: Keep diagnostics and emotional expressions readable under alarm.
shots.movement: Tight instrumentation insert then restrained two-character response.
shots.lighting: Controlled cool-shift and practical warning lights without exposure clipping.
shots.vfx: Desynchronized harmonic pulse, sparking contact, temporal visual shimmer.
shots.interaction_handoff: Ender's attempted correction changes visible diagnostics; fuel cause remains unresolved.

shots.composition: Ship descent path, sea surface scale and captain's agency share frame.
shots.movement: Following camera with stable world horizon; limit camera shake.
shots.lighting: Storm-filtered natural light, retained hull silhouette.
shots.vfx: Air shear ribbons, increasing spray and wing articulation.
shots.interaction_handoff: Controlled sea-entry is player-visible, never a scene-skip proxy.

shots.composition: Continuous physical hull-to-water contact and meaningful buoyancy cues.
shots.movement: Held side-on confirmation shot, no cut before sea-contact evidence.
shots.lighting: Soft rim on hull; ocean highlights not clipped.
shots.vfx: Displaced water, wake, plausible foam and sinking/rebound response.
shots.interaction_handoff: Contact observation comes from native water physics.

shots.composition: Stable floating hull remains in frame continuously for witnessed duration.
shots.movement: Locked uninterrupted shot; no edit or fade across evidence window.
shots.lighting: Stable sky and water exposure with clear reference horizon.
shots.vfx: Residual waves decay; buoyancy and vertical speed remain observable.
shots.interaction_handoff: At least 2.0 seconds independent pre-transition world-time frames.

shots.composition: Human-scale aftermath with Lyra and Talen safely grounded; found-family tension.
shots.movement: Slow steady walk-up, reserved eyelines and space around Talen.
shots.lighting: Gentle coastal aftermath light, warm characters against cool sea.
shots.vfx: Subtle shoreline foam, damp fabrics, atmospheric depth.
shots.interaction_handoff: Lyra introduced only after real splashdown; Talen never playable.
